svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Entity Query 完整时序

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Entity Query 完整时序
REST 与 WebSocket 初始查询入口
resolve dynamic values even when userValue exists
resolve dynamic values even when userValue exists
direct candidate find without dynamic resolution
handler calls setAndResolveQuery a second time
createSubCtx and handler each call setAndResolveQuery
validate filter, relation query and page link
public find false; SYS count/internal may ignore permission
preserve duplicate projections; merge sort/grouped filters
build permission + entity filter + entity-field WHERE
bind latest key and predicate parameters
choose registered entityTableMap entry for FROM
build WITH RECURSIVE source for FROM
path starts at root; append current in_id
cycle out_id may emit once, then expansion stops
recursive IDs then fixed target table for FROM
Count 与 data 是两个 statement
totalElements (find uses Integer; count uses long)
add ORDER BY and LIMIT/OFFSET to data SQL
Count and data do not share one database snapshot.
Without ORDER BY, offset pagination is unstable.
async TS/attribute key queries by entity IDs
[until effective max level or no rows]
follow FROM or TO edges in COMMON group
require current edge in_id absent from path, then append it
emit out_id; a cycle target may appear once
apply relation type/entity type result filters after recursion
Business relation/entity filters do not prune intermediate CTE edges.
long query, no repository query timeout
pageSize * page uses int and may overflow.
[WebSocket initial fetch throws before local catch]
Neither a client error frame nor a close is guaranteed on this path.
